User (2.8s): Twenty third of February nineteen eighty nine.

Assistant (4.7s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (6.5s): Nine nine zero four.

Assistant (9.2s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 7740 has a past-due amount of 365.00, which is 8 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (10.4s): I cannot pay that today.

Assistant (11.6s): I understand. For your credit card ending 7740, can you make a payment of 365.00 on Friday 16 October 2026?

User (13.7s): Yes, I can pay the full amount this Friday.

Assistant (15.1s): To confirm: you will pay 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (16.1s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (17.1s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (18.0s): Thank you. Your promise of 365.00 for the credit card ending 7740 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
